name: Asakawa (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Asakawa town emblem in white: a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised letter A.
history: Municipal flag of Asakawa, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 1968.

features.role: Asakawa town emblem — a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised letter A
